title: Standardized Export Summaries
notes: Redesigns the Shot Diagram and Drill Log export summaries with one standardized visual hierarchy.
Promotes hole diameter, drilled depth range, total hole footage, and average hole depth.
Moves document metadata and page count into compact secondary positions.
Counts a hole as loaded when either Primary Load or Secondary/Special Load contains a value.
Does not classify Dirt or Bad holes as unloaded holes.
Adds a Loading Configurations page for cross-section preparation.
Groups holes by matching Primary and Secondary/Special load recipes while showing depth, stemming, and loaded-column ranges.
Lists exact Primary and Secondary/Special values, calculated pounds, hole count, and example hole IDs for every configuration.
Marks the lightest and heaviest configurations and shows their exact recipe on the main Shot Diagram summary.
Preserves pumped-emulsion pounds as manual pound entries and uses the selected hole diameter for ANFO weight.
Leaves all Drill Log templates, Shot Diagram templates, field-entry screens, and saved document formats unchanged.
Preserves configurable Auto ANFO, inferred timing, Page Order / Renumber, iPad entry layout, right-click shortcuts, and cloud sync behavior.
